painpoints.text: fabro-af22 sits at the top of `sd ready` (High) but is unactionable in this tree: its fix lives in upstream PR fabro-sh/fabro#784 (verified still OPEN via web fetch this run, 01M2W2CMK2SP2WK85FFGJT85CA) and its own body says close only after that PR merges and lands on denkhaus. The tracker has no blocker field to express 'waiting on upstream', so it will keep polluting the top of the ready list every run. Suggestion: a `blocked-upstream` label or a dependency note the planner preflight can skip mechanically.

The `fabro_runs_list` tool returns 75 runs with full JSON per run — most of it irrelevant to the in-flight check (only status + PR state + goal matter). A `status=active` filter or compact mode would cut planner context cost meaningfully (run 01M2W2CMK2SP2WK85FFGJT85CA).
